content_sections.body: Work without notes first. For the situation 'retelling a travel experience', say one sentence that meets this goal: Review a short travel account, follow-up question, and repair. Then check the model: 'I explained the journey in order and checked that my friend understood.' Identify one word or phrase that makes the message clear.
content_sections.title: Recall and select (8 minutes)

content_sections.body: Give one clear response for retelling a travel experience, then ask a partner one follow-up question. Compare the response with the model and repair one missing time, reason, place, quantity, or next step. Use the whole unit's familiar language rather than memorising one sentence.
content_sections.title: Compare two responses (8 minutes)

content_sections.body: Before the unit test, check three things: the main message is clear, one useful detail is included, and the listener knows what happens next. Say or write a new short message about a similar situation, not the model about retelling a travel experience.
content_sections.title: Self-check and transfer (6 minutes)

constraints: Name the learner and tutor roles before the first turn.
Use at most three tutor turns and stop after the agreed next step.
speaking.goal: Complete a clear, practical exchange about retelling a travel experience.
speaking.instruction: Roleplay retelling a travel experience. Learner role: explain the situation and give one useful detail. Tutor role: be a helpful listener, ask one specific follow-up, and confirm the next step. Begin with a natural greeting and finish once both roles agree on the next action.

constraints: Wait for the learner draft before giving feedback.
Give concise feedback only; do not replace the learner draft.
writing.goal: Write a connected, useful short message about retelling a travel experience.
writing.instruction: Write a 35–50 word message about retelling a travel experience. Include the main event or plan, one precise detail, and the next action or response. Submit your own draft before requesting feedback.
